$description: Treemap (platform/charts/Treemap.jsx; library wave 9, lane C): its component tokens. Tiles take their data-viz color (data-plx-dataviz); everything else is an existing role.

treemap-gap-color.$description: Treemap: the gap between tiles, in the surface color.

treemap-gap-width.$description: Treemap: the gap's width (a stroke around each tile).

treemap-label-text.$description: Treemap: a tile's name and value.

treemap-label-font-weight.$description: Treemap: a tile's name, a step above its value.

treemap-value-font-family.$description: Treemap: a tile's value: the data font (DM Mono).

treemap-label-font-size.$description: Treemap: the size of a tile's name and value (the chart labels' size).

treemap-label-halo-color.$description: Treemap: the halo around a tile's name and value, in the surface color, so they read on the tile's color.

treemap-group-border-color.$description: Treemap, nested: the frame around a group.

treemap-group-border-width.$description: Treemap, nested: the group frame's width.

treemap-group-label-text.$description: Treemap, nested: a group's name above its tiles.

treemap-group-label-font-family.$description: Treemap, nested: a group's name (UI text).

treemap-group-label-font-size.$description: Treemap, nested: a group's name size.

treemap-group-label-font-weight.$description: Treemap, nested: a group's name weight.
